title: Applying an Action to a Clock-Host Configuration
statement: Let $s,a$ be nonnegative integers, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and choose an input-head movement, one write-and-move instruction for each of the $s$ yardstick tapes, one for each of the $a$ simulated tapes, and one for the clock tape. Also choose an optional output bit, initial and successor clock-phase states, an input-head position, the contents and head positions of each group of tapes, and an output word. Applying the assembled action to the host configuration with initial phase and these tape data yields the host configuration with successor phase, the input head moved by the chosen clamped movement, each tape updated by its instruction with its head advanced by the chosen movement, and the output bit appended to the output word.
hypotheses_covered: Write-and-move instructions for the yardstick, simulated, and clock tapes
